_source: Godot: player_controller_3d.gd 1923-1935 (clip choice), remote_players.gd 736-763 and 1194-1215 (remote clip + pace), model_slot.gd 444 (crouch fade), player_stride.gd + hunter_stride.gd (pace). Read by render/anim/runner.rs.
_crouch: Crouching plays IDLE (the imported crouch pose folds knees and elbows backward) and fades the body to this alpha; fade_rate is move_toward units per second.

stride._note: References at authored size (assets/hunters_blocky/stride_table.json, player_mannequin); the rig's own stride table wins when it has the clip. Multiplied by model_scale (PlayerModels.SCALE).
